title: Programs & Packages
intro: Structured programmes built around a stage of life rather than a single complaint.
note: DUMMY CONTENT — durations and inclusions below are invented for review. Pricing is deliberately omitted. Replace with the clinic’s real programme details before launch.

items.name: Pregnancy Care Package
items.summary: From the first trimester to term: monthly consultation, month-appropriate diet, gentle therapy where indicated, and prenatal education for both parents.

items.name: Postnatal Recovery Package
items.summary: Structured Sutika Paricharya from the days after delivery, adjusted for a vaginal birth or caesarean recovery.

items.name: Mother & Baby Package
items.summary: Mother and infant treated together in the same session, in a suite arranged around the feeding schedule.

items.name: Women's Wellness Package
items.summary: A general reset for women who are not unwell but not right — sleep, energy, cycle, digestion.

items.name: PCOS Program
items.summary: A long-horizon programme combining internal medicine, therapy, diet and lifestyle change, reviewed monthly.

items.name: Fertility Fit Programme
items.summary: Preconception preparation for one or both partners, focused on readiness rather than intervention.

items.name: Child Development Program
items.summary: For children needing sustained support with growth, immunity, digestion or developmental milestones.

items.name: Mental Wellness Program
items.summary: Psychological care and Ayurvedic therapy run together rather than in parallel.

items.name: Seasonal Detox Program
items.summary: Ritucharya — the classical seasonal cleanse, timed to the change of season.
